drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy with CC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 70-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.4, creatinine 0.8-0.83, hemoglobin 13.9, platelets 264-271, sodium 131-132, wbc 5.9-6.1; vitals dbp 66-71, heart_rate 72-76, map 88-93, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-17, sbp 132-139, spo2 95-96, temp 36.7-37
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Fluid restriction 1.2 L/day; Sodium chloride 1 g PO TID
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. Hyponatremia.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.79-0.83, hemoglobin 13.8-13.9, platelets 262-271, sodium 134-135, wbc 5.6-6; vitals dbp 66-72, heart_rate 72-76, map 89-93, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-18, sbp 133-138, spo2 95-97, temp 36.7-36.9
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. Hyponatremia. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 70-year-old male, length of stay 4 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. Hyponatremia. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed.
